title: How to Build a Referral Program App With AI (No Code Required)
summary: Build a custom referral program with unique referral codes, tracking, and reward management — no ReferralHero, no Viral Loops, no backend developer. Database and auth included.
body_markdown: One-sided referrals reward only the person who referred. Double-sided referrals — like Dropbox's "give 500MB, get 500MB" model — reward both the referrer and the new signup. Double-sided programs consistently convert at higher rates because the referred user has a concrete incentive to complete signup. Dropbox's[3,900% growth](https://techcrunch.com/tag/dropbox/) was driven specifically by this mechanic. The tradeoff is higher reward cost per conversion; budget for this before launch.
